<function name="SetFilePlayed" parent="steamworks" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Sets whether you have played this addon or not. This will be shown to the user in the Steam Workshop itself:
<image src="steamworksSetFilePlayedExample.png"/>
	</description>
	<realm>Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="workshopid" type="string">The Steam Workshop item ID</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="string">Whatever you have put in as first argument</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
